text.content:
The best emergency care money can buy, if you paid.

Industry: Subscription emergency medicine, by armed AV
In Night City: Owns and runs Night City Medical Center in Little China
Known for: The Platinum Plan: biomonitoring, a three-minute response time, and more

Trauma Team's help depends on your plan. At the top, the Platinum Plan watches your biomonitor through your neuroport around the clock and promises a team at your side within three minutes.

Its public relations make its crews look like heroes. Plenty of people find out the hard way that a Trauma Team AV overhead isn't coming for them.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.24
